metadata.title: EA-CTL-SYSML-001 SysML v2 Systems Specifications Standard and enforcement (candidate)
metadata.remarks: Candidate representation only; no OSCAL schema certification or governance approval implied.

controls.title: Primary SysML v2 Systems Specifications Standard

parts.name: statement
parts.prose: Specify new and materially changed in-scope systems using OMG SysML v2.0, with canonical system identity, typed boundaries and interfaces, requirements and allocations, behaviour, calculation constraints where applicable, verification and model/source provenance. Retain existing recorded gaps; require independently reviewed modelling and approval before production release.

parts.name: guidance
parts.prose: SysML v2 is systems specification, not a substitute for TOGAF, ArchiMate, financial/accounting calculation assurance or legal decisions. The local profile validator and supplementary OpenSysML parser do not certify OMG v2.0 conformance. A valid Group CEO approval, approved parser/semantic evidence, protected CI and deployment gates remain separately required and on HOLD.
